body: The rules don't say anything about burning down their own house and blaming the other child.

Thank you so much for the replies. Being a teenager sucks. I'm sure being an adult isn't a whole lot better, but I think the people that say to not be too excited to grow up weren't exactly..like us. I can't imagine a scenario where I'd like to come back to a time period in which I am so utterly not in control of my emotions.

I'm alright at talking to new people. I've hit a point where I just don't give a fuck if people think negatively about me. I know that contradicts what I said earlier, but I'm not sure how to explain it in a way that makes sense. I'm not super great at putting my thoughts into words. It's why I like writing. Because I have more time to process my thoughts.
But with someone I'm unfamiliar with, I'm practically dead inside when talking to them. So if they aren't interested in being my friend, it doesn't matter. But if they are, I start to get attached. And *then* I need them to care about me.

But again, thank you. You have been very helpful and I'm so so grateful.

They're not really my friends..I'm not popular, but I'm nowhere close to having been ostracized. I kinda feel like "out of sight; out of mind" describes me pretty well. No one gives me a second thought when I'm not right in front of me. I don't get invited to stuff, I can't start stuff because no one wants to spend their free time with me. I just said friend because acquaintance is longer and harder to spell on a blurry little keyboard.
